In the line 1...Nf3+ 2.Kh1 Nxh3+ 3.Kg1 (or Kg2), Black has won the queen.

**Coaching note:**
Always look for checks with your pieces, especially when your opponent has just moved. Here, the knight check forces White's king to abandon the defense of the queen. When your piece can give check, scan whether it attacks or exposes undefended enemy pieces after the king moves—this pattern wins material constantly at every level.
